mapper.select: select email from apply where id=#{applyId}
mapper.insert: insert into apply (email, cate, subcate, grade,sexual, day, time, locale, locale3, month, gawetime,price1, price2, message, postingdate, visible) values (#{email}, #{cate}, #{subcate}, #{grade}, #{sexual}, #{day}, #{time}, #{locale}, #{locale3}, #{month}, #{gawetime}, #{price1}, #{price2}, #{message}, #{postingdate}, #{visible})
mapper.select: (select membership from members where email=#{email}) union all (select count(*) from applylist where apply_id=#{apply_id} and teacheremail=#{email}) union all (select count(*) from applylist where apply_id=#{apply_id})
mapper.insert: insert into applylist (apply_id, message, teacheremail, applyDate, applicantemail) values (#{apply_id}, #{message}, #{teacherEmail}, #{applyDate}, #{applicantEmail})
mapper.delete: delete from apply where id=#{id} and email=#{email}
delete from applylist where apply_id=#{id} and applicantemail=#{email}
mapper.select: select count(*) from profile where email=#{email}
select count(*) from apply where email = #{email}
select count(*) from apply where locale like concat('%',#{locale},'%') and cate=#{cate} and grade like concat('%',#{grade},'%') and sexual like concat('%',#{sexual},'%')
select A.name,A.email, B.* from members as A, apply as B where A.email = B.email and B.id=#{id}
